ss_sevenseg_decode.name: ss_sevenseg_decode
ss_sevenseg_decode.description: Decimal/HEX/raw digit decoder; blank masks dot too. bit 0=A through bit 6=G. ACTIVE_LOW includes dp.
ss_sevenseg_decode.inputNotes: Decimal/HEX/raw digit decoder; blank masks dot too. bit 0=A through bit 6=G. ACTIVE_LOW includes dp.

ss_sevenseg_digits.name: ss_sevenseg_digits
ss_sevenseg_digits.description: Pack 1–16 decimal/HEX digits into active-high pattern bytes. Byte i selects common i; nibble i is digit i.
ss_sevenseg_digits.inputNotes: Pack 1–16 decimal/HEX digits into active-high pattern bytes. Byte i selects common i; nibble i is digit i.

ss_sevenseg_scan.name: ss_sevenseg_scan
ss_sevenseg_scan.description: Share the main clock. Two blank clocks per slot prevent ghosting. Frame snapshots at wrap. en=0 blanks and restarts scan.
ss_sevenseg_scan.inputNotes: Share the main clock. Two blank clocks per slot prevent ghosting. Frame snapshots at wrap. en=0 blanks and restarts scan.
